newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai air cargo volumes up 17 percent in March.
newsitem.headline: Dubai air cargo volumes up 17 percent in March.

text.p: Dubai airport cargo volumes rose 17.33 percent in March to 36,324 tonnes from 30,959 tonnes in the same month last year, Dubai Cargo Village figures show.
Exports rose a year-on-year 10.5 percent to 16,626 tonnes, and imports moved up almost 24 percent to 19,698 tonnes. The figures include transit goods but do not include courier and mail items.
Transhipments in the month totalled 6,998 tonnes, a 38 percent increase on March 1996's figure.
Courier and mail volumes dropped a year-on-year four percent to 886 tonnes.
Sea-air freight volumes continued to drop year-on-year, falling 25 percent in March to 5,218 tonnes. This follows drops of 20 percent in February and one percent in January.
Dubai is the second largest emirate and commercial centre of the seven members of the United Arab Emirates.
